toolInput.question: What did we decide about rate limiting on the public API?

toolOutput.answer:
**Token bucket per API key, 600 requests a minute.** The team settled this in the Feb 12 platform sync [1] after the burst incident on Feb 9 [2]. Priya owns the rollout; the first cut ships behind an opt-in header so partners can move early [3].

**Two things are still open.** Per-endpoint overrides were parked until a customer asks for them [1], and the partner usage page has no owner yet [4].

**One more window note.** A three-week digest scan also touched this thread [5], though its body was never read for this answer.
